# @metator/cli

<!-- metator:generated:start -->

## Responsibility

Driving adapter on commander: one module per command group, JSON-only output, exit codes. `guard *` commands answer hooks in the host's protocol instead of the envelope (ADR-0038). `src/tui/` is the full-screen `metator ui` on Ink (ADR-0060): the view knows only `TuiService`, which works on the repositories' containers; the screen goes to stderr.

## Invariants

- Commander never prints; every outcome becomes one JSON envelope [[cite: packages/cli/src/program.ts:71 | ".configureOutput({ writeOut: () => {}, writeErr: () => {} })"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` and `@metator/runtime`. Commands resolve use cases from the container and never construct adapters (MT-ARCH-007).

## Pitfalls

- Validate option values with commander (`choices`, `argParser`), not by hand (MT-CODE-004).
- A new command must be added to the help list in `e2e/cli.e2e.test.ts`.
- A hook must not fail the host's tool call: `guard *` always exits 0 and reports its own errors as `systemMessage`.
- Only the command a person typed may ask questions (`ctx.prompter`, set by `main.ts` for a TTY); questions go to stderr so stdout stays one envelope, and commands run through `invoke` never ask (ADR-0049).
